header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Adnan Khan vs. Federation of Pakistan and others)
(Muhammad Ehtisham vs. Federation of Pakistan and others)
Petitioner(s) : Through Mr. Ishrat Ali Lohar, advocate
body: Zulfiqar Ali Sangi, J: Through the instant petitions, the petitioner(s) are seeking the following relief(s):a. That This Honourable Court may be pleased to suspend the operation of the Impugned proceedings of misconduct till the final adjudication of the instant Petition.

b. That this Honorable Court may very graciously be pleased to direct the Official Respodents not to take any coercive action against the service of Petitioner. c. That this Honorable Court may be pleased to set aside the impugned proceedings of misconduct which is null & void based on conjecture and surmises as voidab-into & contrary to Pakistan WAPDA Employees (E&N) Rules 1978.

d. Any other relief which deem fit and proper. These petitions were filed in the year 2023 and are pending since then without any progress. The perusal of the petitions reflects that it was filed against the private entities, wherein the petitioner(s) are seeking directions to the respondents not to take any coercive action against the service of petitioner(s), and to set-aside the proceedings of misconduct against them. However, the Hon’ble Supreme Court of Pakistan in case of Pakistan Electric Power Company v. Syed Salahuddin and others, (2022 SCMR 991), laid down the principles that petition against private company is not maintainable.
In view of aforesaid principle laid down by the Hon’ble Supreme Court of Pakistan, these petitions are not maintainable, which are hereby dismissed.
